notes:
{益|えき} means benefit, profit, or advantage. Often appears in compound words rather than standalone.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧: profit, benefit, gain
- ⟦{有益|ゆうえき}→有益：13004_yuueki⟧: beneficial, useful, instructive
- ⟦{無益|むえき}→無益：noentry⟧: useless, futile, pointless
- ⟦{公益|こうえき}→公益：16061_koueki⟧: public interest, common good
- ⟦{収益|しゅうえき}→収益：06302_shuueki⟧: earnings, proceeds
- ⟦{損益|そんえき}→損益：09230_soneki⟧: profit and loss
- ⟦{実益|じつえき}→実益：noentry⟧: practical benefit

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{益々|ますます}→ますます：01604_masumasu⟧: more and more, increasingly
- {益|えき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to be beneficial
- {益|えき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: there is benefit
- {益|えき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: there is no benefit

FORMS:
The kanji {益|えき} carries the meaning of "increase" or "profit." It appears in many formal and business contexts.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{得|とく}→得：12563_toku⟧: gain, advantage (everyday)
- ⟦{利点|りてん}→利点：11787_riten⟧: advantage, merit
- ⟦{利|り}→利：noentry⟧: profit, benefit
